[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Jaesa Willsaam]] flew a '''corvette''' that was similar to the [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]] before joining [[Darth Baras]]'s [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]]. While visually identical to the ''Defender''-class, her ship was twice as large and featured a radically different layout.

==History==
[[File:JaesaWillsaamsCorvetteInteriorLayout-SWTOR.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Interior layout of Jaesa's ship.]]
[[Jaesa Willsaam]], the apprentice of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Nomen Karr]], owned a corvette similar to the [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class]], and she arranged to meet the [[Empire's Wrath|Sith apprentice]] who was hunting her in a remote part of space. However, her master learned of Willsaam's plan and sent Knights [[Ulldin]] and [[Zylixx]] in her place. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] fought and killed the two Jedi upon discovering the deception, and the vessel was abandoned in space after the battle.<ref name="The Plan is Working">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|The Plan is Working!|Jaesa Willsaam's corvette}}</ref>
